high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "judiciary_aspirants." The post features a flowchart diagram illustrating the structure of the Indian Judiciary system. The title at the top reads "Indian Judiciary" and is labeled as "INTEGRATED JUDICIARY." The flowchart begins with the President at the top, who oversees the Supreme Court, which includes the Chief Justice and Judges. The Supreme Court is connected to the Parliament. Below the Supreme Court, there are High Courts, also led by a Chief Justice and Judges, and these are further connected to the Governor.
